summary: Confirmed all 28 requested estimates against the complete markdown conversion, including the end matter, and direct PDF text extraction of the cited pages. Figures 1-4 (PDF pp. 16-19) were also inspected visually in memory. All 28 records describe figure-only final-draft comparisons and contain null statistics and counts. The plots print no numerical arm summaries, pairwise effects, tests, intervals, or analysis-specific counts; no values were inferred from plotted positions or participant totals preceding model-specific exclusions. The outcome, evaluator, arms, construct, measure, unit, direction, timing, comparison type, within_person, and se_basis coding are supported. AI-first final drafts were written independently after AI-assisted first drafts, correctly coded after_ai with outcome_with_ai false and immediate timing; AI-follow and AI-parallel final drafts are with_ai with outcome_with_ai true. The printed AI-first and AI-parallel ANCOVA results adjust for already AI-assisted first drafts and are appropriately excluded under rule 5. Section 3.4 does not identify the evaluator of its numerical subdomain results, so those numbers cannot be assigned to either evaluator-specific plot. All 84 source references match their cited PDF pages. The ten script warnings are false positives caused by a sentence spanning the page break: PDF p. 6, Section 2.4 ends with "AI-parallel assistance, where both drafts were developed" and PDF p. 7 continues "collaboratively with AI;". The complete recorded quote is verbatim when the intervening "Page 6/20" footer is removed and whitespace is normalized. The outcome/contrast inventory contains the eligible first- and final-draft outcomes for both evaluators and the separately recorded evaluator-unspecified AI-follow subdomain results. No additional eligible outcome or reported AI-configuration contrast was found in the supplied paper under rules 4-6. Numerical verification was limited to the 28 requested records.
